$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (visual-flow-orchestration). Declares the `flow` schema (an ordered, declarative multi-step pipeline of existing Source/Mapping/Synchronization/Endpoint/Approval references) plus its `flow_run`/`flow_run_log` execution-trace schemas, and additively extends `approval_request` (declared by hitl-approval-rule-action.json) with `flowRunId`/`resumeStepOrder` so an `approval` flow step can suspend/resume through the same approval_request state machine. See openspec/changes/archive/2026-07-15-visual-flow-orchestration/design.md Decisions 1/4/6. Deep-merge note: this fragment only adds the two new `approval_request` properties (InitializeRegister::deepMergeConfig unions `components.schemas.approval_request.properties` by key with hitl-approval-rule-action.json's — glob sort places this file after the `h...` fragment alphabetically, so the union always sees the base schema first); it does not repeat approval_request's existing properties/required/seed data.

flow.title: Flow
flow.summary: A declarative, ordered multi-step pipeline referencing existing Source/Mapping/Synchronization/Endpoint/Approval entities by id
flow.description: An ordered list of steps (call/mapping/synchronization/event/approval/branch), each a thin reference to an existing entity. Executed by FlowRunnerService, which calls the referenced entity's own existing service method — no step type reimplements that logic. See openspec/specs/flow-orchestration/spec.md REQ-001.

isEnabled.description: When false, cron/endpoint/event triggers skip this flow; a manual Run still executes it (matches job/synchronization isEnabled precedent)
isEnabled.title: Enabled

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: Ordered list of flow steps. Execution order is each item's own `order` field (a stable identifier), not array position, so `branch` targets (nextStepOrder/defaultNextStepOrder) stay valid across insert/delete/reorder edits in the step-list editor. `order` values MUST be unique within a flow — FlowRunnerService::run() rejects a flow with duplicate step `order` values as a fatal configuration error before executing any step, and the step-list editor validates the same rule client-side before save.

order.description: Stable step identifier and default execution sequence (ascending). branch steps' nextStepOrder/defaultNextStepOrder reference this value, not array position. MUST be unique within the flow.
order.title: Order

type.description: Which existing service this step dispatches to: call -> CallService::call(), mapping -> MappingService::executeMapping(), synchronization -> SynchronizationService::synchronize(), event -> EventService::emitCloudEvent(), approval -> suspend/resume via ApprovalService, branch -> JsonLogic-selected next step (no service call).
type.title: Type

configRef.description: Id of the existing Source (call) / Mapping (mapping) / Synchronization (synchronization) entity this step invokes. Not applicable to event/approval (config carries their parameters) or branch steps.
configRef.title: Config Reference

condition.description: Optional JsonLogic run-if rule, evaluated via JWadhams\JsonLogic::apply() against the current step context. Step runs only when this evaluates loosely true. Absent/empty = always run.
condition.title: Condition

onError.description: stop: flow_run.status becomes stopped, no later step runs. continue: the run proceeds to the next step. dead_letter: flow_run.status becomes dead_letter (distinct from stopped), no later step runs.
onError.title: On Error

config.description: Type-specific parameters this step's dispatch needs beyond configRef: call={endpoint?, method?, requestConfig?}; event={source, subject?, type} (EventService::emitCloudEvent() args, design.md Decision 5); approval={approverGroup, onReject?, onTimeout?, ttlSeconds?} (mirrors the approval rule action's own config shape); synchronization={isTest?, force?, mutationType?} (optional overrides, default off so sync-safety guards are never bypassed by a flow step).
config.title: Step Configuration

branches.description: branch steps only. Evaluated in array order via JsonLogic::apply(); the first matching entry's nextStepOrder is selected.
branches.title: Branches

nextStepOrder.description: The order of the step to jump to when this branch's condition matches

defaultNextStepOrder.description: branch steps only. Used when no branches[].condition matches. When absent, execution continues to the next step in order sequence.
defaultNextStepOrder.title: Default Next Step Order

flow_run.title: Flow Run
flow_run.summary: One FlowRunnerService::run() invocation, with the step-level trace in flow_run_log
flow_run.description: Minimal, self-contained execution-trace schema for v1 (design.md Decision 6). If execution-trace-observability lands a cross-cutting execution_trace schema, a follow-up change SHOULD converge flow_run_log onto it rather than maintaining both indefinitely.

flowId.description: FK to the flow this run executed
flowId.title: Flow

triggerSource.description: Which of the four trigger surfaces started this run (flow-orchestration REQ-007)
triggerSource.title: Trigger Source

status.description: running while steps execute; completed when every step finishes (or is skipped/continue-recovers); stopped on an onError:stop failure or a rejected approval step; dead_letter on an onError:dead_letter failure or a dead-lettered approval outcome; suspended while an approval step awaits sign-off; failed on a fatal configuration error (e.g. an unresolvable branch target, REQ-004) that is not an ordinary step failure.
status.title: Status

finishedAt.description: When this run reached a terminal status (completed/stopped/dead_letter/failed). Null while running or suspended.
finishedAt.title: Finished At

flow_run_log.title: Flow Run Log
flow_run_log.summary: One per-step trace entry for a flow_run
flow_run_log.description: Append-only per-step execution trace (flow-orchestration REQ-008), mirroring the job_log/synchronization_log append-only+immutable convention.

flowRunId.description: FK to the owning flow_run; deleted along with it
flowRunId.title: Flow Run

stepOrder.description: The step's `order` value (flow.steps[].order), not array position
stepOrder.title: Step Order

status.description: completed: the step's dispatch succeeded. skipped: the step's condition evaluated false (REQ-003). failed: the step's dispatch threw (REQ-006).
status.title: Status

error.description: Present only when status=failed — the caught throwable's message
error.title: Error

flowRunId.description: FK to the flow_run this request suspended (flow `approval` step case); set instead of endpointId/ruleId/synchronizationId. See flow-orchestration REQ-005.
flowRunId.title: Flow Run

resumeStepOrder.description: The `order` of the flow step to resume at once this request is approved — the step immediately after the suspending `approval` step (flow-orchestration REQ-005). Not applicable to the endpoint-rule or Synchronization batch-gate cases.
resumeStepOrder.title: Resume Step Order
